title: Alikeenie Community SMP
description: A light mod pack to enhance quality of life for a vanilla friendly game play.
body:
This modpack adds mods that improve gameplay in a vanilla friendly way. It allows for easier farming, exploration, and mining. It also adds player and mob heads to allow you to display them throughout your base. This is perfect for a lightly modded server or your next SMP.
Mods include:
•    Armor Statues to display armor in different poses
•    Lootr to allow every to have a unique inventory for each player that opens the chest
•    Macaws Holiday for a limited time only, to decorate your world with seasonal items
•    Right Click Harvest so you can easily harvest items without replanting seeds
•    Traveller Backpacks's which allows you to equip a backpack and take it with you on your travels!
•    Tree vein miner to allow you to chop down whole tree in one go!
•    Explorer's & Nature Compass to find nearby structures, towns, and biomes
•    Rotten Leather+ to be able to turn rotten flesh into leather
•    Universal Bone Meal to allow you to bone meal all plants in the game
•    Veinminer to quickly mine any Minecraft blocks you want
•    Waystone to allow you to transport easily throughout the world
•    Magnum torches to protect bases from monsters
This modpack includes a small collection of mods to improve quality of life on Minecraft like being able to have backpacks and easily explore to allow players to play Minecraft more easily.
